value.rationale: Sharp complete universal classification of fixed signed compact self-adjoint perturbations acting on the positive reducing-subspace norm-attaining cone; arbitrarily large, noncommuting, infinite-rank positive compacts are covered with multiple essential spectral levels, while every infinite negative tail fails, even traceclass and arbitrarily small. This distinguishes two mathematically natural operator stability directions and addresses an active quantitative/classification gap beyond one-base perturbation tests.
